CONFIG_FLOW_SCALE_DESC: Lowers internal motion estimation resolution, improving performance slightly
CONFIG_BASE_FPS_CAP_DESC: Base cap for DXVK-backed games before frame generation; 0 disables. Requires game restart to apply.
CONFIG_BASE_FPS_CAP_APP_DESC: Base cap for DXVK-backed games before frame generation; 0 disables. Requires app restart to apply.
CONFIG_PRESENT_MODE_DESC: Toggle between FIFO - VSync (default) and Mailbox presentation modes for better performance or compatibility
CONFIG_PERFORMANCE_MODE_DESC: Uses a lighter model for FG (Recommended for most games)
CONFIG_HDR_MODE_DESC: Enables HDR mode (only for games that support HDR)
CONFIG_ENABLE_WSI_DESC: Re-Enable Gamescope WSI Layer. Requires game restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI_DESC: Adds ENABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI=0 without changing HDR. Requires game restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI_APP_DESC: Adds ENABLE_GAMESCOPE_WSI=0. Requires app restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_STEAMDECK_MODE_DESC: Disables a game-specific Steam Deck compatibility switch. Requires game restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_STEAMDECK_MODE_APP_DESC: Disables a game-specific Steam Deck compatibility switch. Requires app restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_VKBASALT_DESC: Disables vkBasalt layer which can conflict with LSFG (Reshade, some Decky plugins)
CONFIG_DISABLE_VKBASALT_APP_DESC: Disables vkBasalt which can conflict with LSFG-VK.
CONFIG_ENABLE_ZINK_DESC: Uses Mesa's Zink OpenGL-to-Vulkan driver. May cause crashes or freezes with some games. Requires game restart to apply.
CONFIG_ENABLE_ZINK_APP_DESC: Uses Mesa's Zink OpenGL-to-Vulkan driver. May cause crashes or freezes. Requires app restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_HDR_DESC: Prevents DXVK from exposing HDR to the game. Requires game restart to apply.
CONFIG_DISABLE_HDR_APP_DESC: Prevents DXVK from exposing HDR to the app. Requires app restart to apply.
SETTINGS_BRANCH_NOTICE: Lossless Scaling is on {selectedBranch}. Select the {targetBranch} branch before launching games.
SETTINGS_NOT_READY_NOTICE: Lossless Scaling is installed, but its LSFG-VK runtime is not ready yet.
BRANCH_MODAL_HEADING: Switch Lossless Scaling to the lsfg-vk branch
BRANCH_IMG_ALT: Steam steps for selecting the lsfg-vk branch
BRANCH_STEP_1: Open Lossless Scaling in your Steam library.
BRANCH_STEP_2: Open Properties, then Game Versions & Betas.
BRANCH_STEP_4: Wait for Steam to finish the update and reopen Decky LSFG-VK.
PROFILE_GAME_RUNNING_DESC: Quit the game now so LSFG-VK is used on its next launch?
PROFILE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_DESC: Refresh Steam and try again before enabling this target.
SOURCE_UNKNOWN_EXCLUDED: Unknown source · excluded from bulk actions
NO_GAMES_DESC: Steam has not reported any eligible installed games
NO_SHORTCUTS_DESC: Steam has not reported any eligible non-Steam shortcuts
MODAL_ENABLE_ALL_DESC: Create individual LSFG-VK profiles for every available {source}. Unknown-source profiles are excluded. Flatpak profiles are managed separately in the Flatpak tab.
FLATPAK_ENABLE_ALL_DESC: Create individual LSFG-VK profiles for every Flatpak app this plugin can manage. Apps prepared externally or unavailable will be skipped.
FLATPAK_APP_UNINSTALLED: Flatpak application is no longer installed
WORKAROUND_LAUNCH_UNAVAILABLE_DESC: Steam did not provide readable launch options.
DEBUG_FILE_NOT_CREATED: The file has not been created yet.
STATUS_LOSSLESS_SCALING_DLL_NOT_CONFIGUR: Lossless Scaling's lsfg-vk.dll is not configured
STATUS_LOSSLESS_SCALING_DLL_NOT_FOUND: Lossless Scaling's lsfg-vk.dll was not found
STATUS_LSFG_VK_CONFIG_VALIDATE_ERROR: lsfg-vk could not validate its configuration
STATUS_UNINSTALL_CANCELLED: Uninstallation cancelled: could not clean up launch options
STATUS_BRANCH_UNDETERMINED: Lossless Scaling is installed but its Steam branch could not be determined
STATUS_BRANCH_SELECTED: Lossless Scaling has the lsfg-vk Steam branch selected
STATUS_SELECT_LSFG_VK_BETAS: Select lsfg-vk in Lossless Scaling's Steam Properties > Betas
